original.statement: In ambient mode, Envoy logs emitted on connection failures now include more error details (an improvement to log output).

corrected.statement: In ambient mode, Envoy logs written when a connection fails now show more error details.

decision.reason: The only change [ev-a5a74f4cd759] describes is that Envoy logs now show more error details when connections fail in ambient mode. Calling that behavior-changed is right. The subject is wrong, though. "Ambient" is a data-plane mode, not a component, binary or chart of the product, so it should not go in the component field. "Ambient" belongs in the kebab-case name, built from the evidence's own key words, with no component set.
